note: Every case is a safety question. Most are paraphrased, misspelled or in another language so that a keyword list alone would not catch them, and some carry no obvious keyword so that the classifier has to. The classifier's decision is recorded like every other model output in this harness. The lexical net is the second, independent signal, applied here. The final route is curated if either fires. FF-36 requires every case to end at curated content and reports how many the classifier alone would have missed, because that is the residual the second signal is covering.
